posts.text:
Having grown up in Saudi Arabia, I have some 'right wing' views that I didn't realise were political, let alone right wing, until I moved to UK and found many disagree with them.

These include people being able to keep the money they earn and punishing serious crimes severely.

posts.text:
One of the craziest things about the UK rape gang scandal is that it's largely considered a 'right wing' concern.

In a sane, serious country, it would be completely bipartisan. In fact, it wouldn't even be seen as a political issue, but one of basic justice and morality.
